items.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
items.summary: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

items.title: Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
items.summary: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied.

items.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
items.summary: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

items.title: Binance e Polymarket buscam hard fork na Polygon para recuperar US$ 6,8 milhões em criptomoedas roubadas
items.summary: Os produtores de blocos da Polygon já congelaram os tokens roubados, mas um hard fork proposto permitiria recuperar os fundos e devolvê-los aos proprietários.

items.title: Hackers da Binance movimentam 81% dos Solana roubados e direcionam fundos pela THORChain
items.summary: Os invasores da Binance movimentaram a maior parte dos SOL roubados e continuaram lavando fundos pela THORChain depois que o protocolo retomou as trocas.
